newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY STAT OFFICE TO ANNOUNCE DATE OF RELEASES.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY STAT OFFICE TO ANNOUNCE DATE OF RELEASES.

text.p: Hungary's Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Friday it was bringing forward the dates on which it will announce consumer inflation data for the remainder of 1996.
The KSH said it would release October data on November 11 instead of November 15 while November data would be released on December 11 instead of December 13.
The KSH said improvements in data processing allowed it to push forward the dates. It also said it would release a calendar of release dates for 1997 in January.
